content.body:
Testing and CI, step 2.5, one role of six. Roles have only ever been proven on the real servers, which is where several bugs were first found.

## What changes

A Molecule scenario for the `access` role through the shared Molecule checks, on AlmaLinux 9 and 10 containers with systemd running: the role applied twice with no changes the second time, and a verify that checks exact values as the account the real service runs as. The scenario lists what a container cannot show for this role, which stays with the live verifies.

## Done when

The scenario passes in CI on both AlmaLinux versions.

items.title: Move an issue to Ready only when it meets the Definition of Ready

content.body:
### Project, step, and reason

Global development workflow, follow-up to G3a (#20). The issue tool adds only the form's type: label and one scope: label, so it can't open a tech-debt issue, which needs tech-debt and a debt: type and origin label (decisions 27 and 28), or mark an issue deferred or workflow-exception.

### What changes

The issue file gains an optional labels list. Each label must be a global label in tools/workflow/labels.toml other than a type: or scope: label, which the form and the scope key already own; anything else is refused before any change, naming the label.

### Done when

An issue file with labels = ["tech-debt", "debt:code", "debt:accidental"] opens an issue carrying them, a type: or scope: label in the list is refused, a label not in labels.toml is refused, and the round's review passes.
